speech: Here's how to start Claude Code from your Documents folder.
caption: Here's how to start Claude Code from your Documents folder.

speech: Press Command Space, to open Spotlight.
caption: Press ⌘ Command + Space to open Spotlight.

speech: Terminal opens in your home folder.
caption: Terminal opens in your home folder (~).

speech: Type C D tilde slash Documents, and press Return.
caption: Type cd ~/Documents and press Return.

speech: P W D shows where you are: Documents.
caption: pwd shows where you are: Documents.

speech: Type claude, and press Return. Claude Code starts in this folder.
caption: Type claude and press Return. Claude Code starts in this folder.

speech: That's it! You'll need Claude Code installed first.
caption: That's it! You'll need Claude Code installed first.
